instruction.text: Change the sentences into the simple past tense.

atoms.a: Masha <u>was hoping</u> to get a new computer for Christmas.
atoms.b: Masha ((hoped)) to get a new computer for Christmas.

atoms.a: We <u>were looking</u> everywhere for our dog.
Cameron <u>waits</u> all day for the traffic to clear up.
atoms.b: Cameron ((waited)) all day for the traffic to clear up.

atoms.a: Rahul <u>is learning</u> all about verb tenses at school.
atoms.b: Rahul ((learnt)) all about verb tenses at school.

atoms.a: The ducklings <u>had followed</u> their mother before the storm started.
atoms.b: The ducklings ((followed)) their mother before the storm started.
